<a id="ai_joystick_rows"></a>
### [`ai_joystick_rows`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L125) `$C9CE-$CA7D`

*data*

AI joystick rows, 8 bytes each (22 rows). $85a0 reads row n at $c9ce+8n. Each byte is a joystick value: bits 0-3 up, down, left, right, bit 4 fire.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_choose_moves`](computer_moves.md#ai_choose_moves)
